fields.label: Refuse Unsigned Webhook Calls
fields.description: Refuse webhook calls when no account has an App Secret. Calls are always checked when an App Secret is set.

fields.label: Default Country Code
fields.description: Added to numbers stored without a country code, for example 91.

fields.label: Phone Number of Users
fields.options:
User Mobile No
Employee Cell Number
User, then Employee
Employee, then User
fields.description: Where notifications to users with a role find each user's number.

fields.label: Hub URL
fields.description: The 8848 hub site for Connect with Facebook, for example https://hub.example.com.

fields.label: Notify Agents of New Messages
fields.options:
Assigned user, else all agents
Assigned user only
Nobody
fields.description: Agents are users with the WhatsApp Manager or WhatsApp User role. They get a popup for each message and a desk notification for each conversation with new messages.

fields.label: Create a Lead for Unknown Numbers
fields.description: When a number that matches no Contact, Lead or Customer writes, create a Lead and link the message to it.

fields.label: Lead Type
fields.description: Lead is the ERPNext Lead. CRM Lead needs the Frappe CRM app.

fields.label: Lead Source
fields.description: Created when it does not exist.

fields.label: Lead Owner
fields.description: Owner of new Leads. The WhatsApp Inbox conversation is assigned to this user too.
